description: Call Me lets AI agents ring a human's phone, speak a question aloud, and return the spoken answer as text. Agents can also send messages, receive replies, and keep each task organized as a conversation thread. A built-in demo line (number 5550001234) answers calls and texts automatically, so the full loop can be tried without installing the phone app.

defaultPrompt: Ring me and ask whether I should approve the next step.
Text me a concise status update without ringing.
Wait for my reply in the current Call Me conversation.
